text:
### Compliance & Regulatory Documents  
| Document Type | Retention Period | Legal Basis |
|---|---|---|
| **Complaint Files** | 6 years from resolution | FCA COBS Part 2 |
| **Regulatory Reports** | 5 years | PRA Rulebook, audit |
| **AML Screening Results** | 5 years post-closure | Money Laundering Regs |
| **SAR (Suspicious Activity)** | 5 years | Proceeds of Crime Act |
| **Audit Reports** | 7 years | Statutory audit |
| **Board/Committee Minutes** | Permanent | Corporate governance |
| **Compliance Bulletins** | 3 years | Regulatory reference |
| **Regulatory Circulars** | 3–5 years | Regulatory guidance |

raw_entities.name: Compliance & Regulatory Documents Retention Policy
raw_entities.description: A governing instrument defining the mandatory retention periods and legal bases for various compliance and regulatory records within FirstUK Bank.

raw_entities.name: Complaint Files Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates that complaint files must be retained for a period of 6 years starting from the date of resolution.

raw_entities.name: FCA Conduct of Business Sourcebook Part 2
raw_entities.description: The regulatory basis for the retention of complaint files.

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Reports Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates that regulatory reports must be retained for a period of 5 years.

raw_entities.name: PRA Rulebook
raw_entities.description: The regulatory basis for the retention of regulatory reports.

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Results Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates that AML screening results must be retained for 5 years following the closure of the account.

raw_entities.name: Money Laundering Regulations
raw_entities.description: The legal basis for the retention of AML screening results.

raw_entities.name: SAR Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates that Suspicious Activity Reports (SAR) must be retained for a period of 5 years.

raw_entities.name: Proceeds of Crime Act
raw_entities.description: The legal basis for the retention of Suspicious Activity Reports.

raw_entities.name: Audit Reports Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates that audit reports must be retained for a period of 7 years.

raw_entities.name: Statutory Audit Requirements
raw_entities.description: The legal basis for the retention of audit reports.

raw_entities.name: Board and Committee Minutes Permanent Retention
raw_entities.description: Mandates that minutes from Board and Committee meetings be retained permanently.

raw_entities.name: Corporate Governance Standards
raw_entities.description: The basis for the permanent retention of board and committee minutes.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Bulletins Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates that compliance bulletins be retained for a period of 3 years.

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Reference Standards
raw_entities.description: The basis for the retention of compliance bulletins.

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Circulars Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates that regulatory circulars be retained for a period between 3 and 5 years.

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Guidance
raw_entities.description: The basis for the retention of regulatory circulars.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Record Keeping
raw_entities.description: The operational mechanism of maintaining a structured retention schedule for regulatory and compliance documentation to ensure legal and regulatory adherence.
